representations.name: ordered endpoint translation orbit
representations.new_information: Keeps both natural endpoints of an actual positive mask and quotients the diagonal Laurent translation action.
representations.first_test: Classify pairs (l,r) modulo (l,r)->(l+c,r+c) and test whether width r-l is complete.

representations.name: Minkowski width homomorphism
representations.new_information: Uses positivity to make both endpoints additive under direct mask products, hence makes width additive.
representations.first_test: Prove min(A+B)=min A+min B and max(A+B)=max A+max B without coefficient cancellation.

representations.name: four-product width graph
representations.new_information: Retains widths of Fj,F0,PAj,PA0 and the exact common-spectrum equations between them.
representations.first_test: Express all four coordinates using d=wd(X), W=wd(V), |lambda_j| and centre constants.

representations.name: fixed-sign scalar width orbit
representations.new_information: Tracks |lambda_j|d on the power-large same-sign class where scalars are distinct.
representations.first_test: Prove injectivity for d>0 and quantify the exact range and fibres.

representations.name: joint phi-width branch diagram
representations.new_information: Compares phi_j=min(lambda_jX) to width(lambda_jX) in positive/negative and zero/nonzero endpoint branches.
representations.first_test: Determine exactly when width is a function of phi and when it separates a constant phi fibre.

representations.name: zero-anchor repair coordinate
representations.new_information: Keeps width on the branch discarded by least-support projection, where phi_j is identically zero.
representations.first_test: Take X with the relevant endpoint zero and distinct same-sign scalars; compare phi and width fibres.

representations.name: known-source residual width
representations.new_information: Subtracts |lambda_j|wd(X), already determined by scalar-copy row data, from every literal width observable.
representations.first_test: Compute whether any complement-width residual varies after the common total width is fixed.

representations.name: literal profile conditioning ledger
representations.new_information: Counts the literal width-profile range separately from its residual information content.
representations.first_test: Compare singleton literal fibres with the residual range and forbid calling source indexing new entropy.

representations.name: divisor width atlas comparison
representations.new_information: Identifies wd(Fj)=wd(G)+wd(Rj)=a+bj with the inherited weighted subset-sum atlas.
representations.first_test: Check that the same-sign distinct bj theorem is exactly the width-profile injection, not independent rigidity.

representations.name: global distance-interface firewall
representations.new_information: Keeps profile range separate from all-target occurrence, Euclidean collision fibres and outer stability.
representations.first_test: Demand explicit exponent inequalities on one common domain before any public promotion.
